title: Docstring Format Schema
description: Validation schema for the declarative docstring_format policy used by the common docstring layer. Syntax is enforced by `docstring.standard.lark`; this schema models semantic policy and check shape.

docstring_schema_version.description: Legacy alias kept for compatibility with earlier schema naming. Prefer docstring_format_version.

docstring_format_version.description: Current policy-version number for this format file.

name.description: Stable contract identifier used by tooling and diagnostics. Usually `docstring_format`.

strict.description: When true, required-section checks are enforced and reported as warnings.

forbidden_summary_phrases.description: Words or phrases not allowed in callable short summaries.

required_summary.description: Require a short non-empty one-line summary in each callable docstring.

required_sections.description: Sections that must exist in callable docstrings under strict mode.

optional_sections.description: Optional callable sections that parser can capture and export. Examples are preserved as opaque text and interpreted by tools by name.

examples.docstring:
Compute deterministic cache key states for one node.

Graph
-----
Return canonical hashes for node state and metadata snapshots.

Role
----
Owns key material normalization and hash formatting responsibilities.

Normalize fields before hashing raw node state.

Graph
-----
Convert dataclass-backed payload into an ordered tuple used by downstream digest functions.

Role
----
Owns low-level canonicalization and null-handling semantics for hashing.

Build deterministic hash states.

Graph
-----
Emit ordered hash tuples for downstream checks.

Pseudocode
----------
1) if missing fields -> initialize defaults
2) for each normalized field
   if field absent -> skip
3) return ordered tuple

section.description: Section name that contains compact execution-script documentation.

max_steps.description: Maximum number of pseudocode steps to accept in a callable docstring.

max_step_chars.description: Maximum number of characters per pseudocode step text.

max_total_chars.description: Maximum total characters across all pseudocode step texts.

module_dependencies.description: Policy mapping callable section names for module dependencies.

calls_section.description: Section name listing module calls referenced by this callable.

allow_implicit.description: Whether dependency entries may be marked as implicit.

validate_declared_calls.description: Require each explicit CallsFromModule declaration to match at least one observed module-level call.

validate_declared_instantiations.description: Require each explicit InstantiationsFromModule declaration to match at least one observed module-level instantiation.

report_unlisted_calls.description: Report module-level calls observed in code that are not listed in CallsFromModule.

report_unlisted_instantiations.description: Report module-level instantiations observed in code that are not listed in InstantiationsFromModule.

ignore_non_external.description: Ignore non-imported symbols when inferring module-level calls and instantiations.

validate_dependency_targets_resolved.description: Require declared dependency entries to resolve to module imports or local symbols.

enforce_declared_dependency_pseudocode_c.description: Require each declared module dependency to be referenced in the callable pseudocode.

enforce_observed_dependency_pseudocode_c.description: Require observed module dependencies in code to be referenced in callable pseudocode.

ownership.description: Policy for `Owns` sections and owner reference parsing.

section.description: Section name that holds ownership declarations.

section_required.description: If true, `Owns` must appear when strict validation runs.

allows_multiple.description: Whether multiple ownership lines are allowed for one callable.

single_owner_per_callable.description: Whether parser/validator treats ownership as singular semantic responsibility.

owner_resolution.description: Resolution strategy for resolving owner ids. Supports `module:Ownable`.

cross_file_enabled.description: Global compatibility switch for cross-file ownership declarations.

enabled.description: Whether cross-file owner resolution is allowed for this policy.

pipeline.description: Validation contract for module-level pipeline docs (`GraphPipeline`).

required.description: Whether `GraphPipeline` must be present in module docs.

required_sections.description: Sections required inside `GraphPipeline` when the block exists.

module.description: Validation contract for module-level documentation and ownership registry.

required.description: Whether module docstring itself is required for validation runs.

required_summary.description: Whether module summary is mandatory when module docs are required.

optional_sections.description: Optional module sections for richer context in docs/visualization.

ownership_registry.description: Configuration for parsing module-owned registry entries.

section.description: Section name that contains ownable registry entries.

allows_multiple.description: Whether multiple ownable entries are allowed.
